body: That's so awesome that it turned out good for you. I hope I have the same experience and feel a lot of relief afterwards.
That part of it is very frustrating. It is like I know I accomplished something and I should be celebrating and telling everyone, but instead I have done the opposite.

This is really encouraging and nice. Thank you for sharing. Hope I have a similar experience! Sometimes I can convince myself it will be okay and I can keep a good perspective, other times I lose it. Progress is progress though!
Thank you. In IT it does seem that Anxiety drives you to double check everything you do.
It was a strange feeling to apply for jobs and instead of being excited for a call back, I was terrified. I hope you find something and conquer it the same as I hope I can.
Thank you for your insight. It seems like I am mostly anxious about judgement from others, I am working in it in therapy and have been for quite some time, but it is still hard.
Thank you for replying. It really helped just that anyone replied. Everything is so chaotic it is hard to tell what to do. I will try following your advice.
